_about: C-240 (the user, 2026-10-29): Halloween's card of the day, with THE HERMETIC LAYER held -- drawn from the Book of Thirteen, one spell a card, three and a half among them. Every word DRAFT.

cards.phrase: You were never off. Only unwatched.
Let there be here, and there.
Come closer. I am not asking.
In naming you, I find my edge.
Once chance, twice rhyme, thrice law.
I went out so I could come back.
I choose. Let the choosing be mine.
I am carried, and do not walk alone.
Wall, remember you are a slow door.
Give me the part. Only the part.
Take the parts away. Feel the shape.
The fold is thin. It was all one.
